properties.decision_summary: Contracts draft.2 accepted the slice's eight proposals as additive changes (local_persisted→admitted, signer_unknown/no_policy_yet quarantine, unauthorized reject, CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE, corrected.by, part-level revoke/override, per-part scope, ruling parts + machine-checkable requirements, propose role, typed evidence_class); admission order is parents/endpoints before capability with no-policy-yet as a retryable quarantine; archived is a flag beside an untouched status; a human key becomes a trusted signer only via out-of-band bootstrap or a principal event signed by an already-trusted human key
